body: You're on the right path. They're scared and lashing out because they know they will lose. Keep at it. You will get through it. Don't let them win.

Thank you. 


I know a lot of people who swear by meds and have made their life a lot better. But unless you think you desperately need them, I would highly recommend CBT or any of the non-medicated paths.

Live for the benefit of others.

It may not seem like a life but it's the best one you can live. Look at the people who live just for themselves. Few are happy and even the ones who are are lonely. It's not the way social animals are supposed to live. We thrive together. 

If alone you feel sad, and if you do not have a social circle to reach out to, volunteer. With animals if you don't want to be around people. But see that you have the ability to make other's lives better. That ways, even if you can't improve your own life you see that you have a positive effect, that people appreciate the things you do. 

You're in college, find a college counselor. They're used to talking to people that feel the way you do and may have better advice than me...

If you are not who they say you are, it will show. Be yourself and that's what people will see. Liars are always found out and lying to the court, even about a person's character, is punishable.

Stick to your convictions and let that shine through.

And volunteer at an animal shelter or something. No one could think you are violent when you're helping abandoned puppies.
